comment: PromQL function definition for Kibana. See https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/functions/
name: absent
description:
Returns an empty vector if the instant vector argument has any element, and a single-element vector with the value `1` otherwise. When the argument is a selector, the result carries the labels of its equality matchers, such as `job="api"` for `absent(http_requests_total{job="api"})`. A label takes the value of its first equality matcher, and is left out when a later matcher names it too, such as `job` in `absent(x{job="api", job!="web"})`. Any other argument gives a result without labels.

The query needs a time range (`start` and `end`, `time`, or a `@timestamp` range filter on the request), because `absent` returns a value at the evaluation steps where the argument has no element.
